# Chatwarden

> Chatwarden is free, open-source chat moderation for games: a check for every chat message (slurs from your word list, optional swearing filter), in-game reporting with evidence, player notices, and a moderator hub (one card per report by default). TypeScript for Node 22.13 or newer. Pre-release (0.1.x), Apache-2.0, provided as-is. It moderates an existing chat; it is not a chat system. Not a child-safety tool.

The packages are small and independent. Start with the repository README, then install `@chatwarden/core`, `@chatwarden/store-sqlite` and `@chatwarden/matcher`. For a moderator screen add `@chatwarden/hub-react` (or `@chatwarden/hub-element`), and `@chatwarden/player-react` for what players see. Every code sample on https://chatwarden.dev/ is copied from these READMEs.

## Docs (README per package)

- [Repository README](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/README.md): what the kit is, the package list and which packages to install for which job.
- [@chatwarden/core](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/core/README.md): the moderation engine (chat verdicts, reports, decisions, notices); no runtime dependencies. Start here.
- [@chatwarden/matcher](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/matcher/README.md): the slur matcher that resists Unicode and leetspeak evasion without blocking innocent words; includes invented test words.
- [@chatwarden/store-sqlite](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/store-sqlite/README.md): the SQLite store for reports, sanctions, notices and the audit trail, on the SQLite built into Node.
- [@chatwarden/store-memory](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/store-memory/README.md): an in-memory store for tests, demos and single-process prototypes; everything is lost on restart.
- [@chatwarden/http](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/http/README.md): HTTP routes for staff and players, signed webhooks and an Express adapter.
- [@chatwarden/profanity](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/profanity/README.md): an optional filter for ordinary swearing that a game can allow, star or block.
- [@chatwarden/discord](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/discord/README.md): posts the staff review queue into a Discord forum through a channel webhook.
- [@chatwarden/hub-react](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/hub-react/README.md): the moderator hub, a React workbench for a team of moderators with one card per report by default, editable steps and reporting, over the staff routes; adopt it as a drop-in `<Hub>`, as pieces, as hooks or headless.
- [@chatwarden/player-react](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/player-react/README.md): the player side, React components for notices, a player's record, the rules and a report dialog (one tap by default).
- [@chatwarden/hub-element](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden/blob/main/packages/hub-element/README.md): the moderator hub as one custom element, `<chatwarden-hub>`, in a single script tag with no React or build step on the page.

## npm packages

- [@chatwarden/core on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/core): the engine; install this first.
- [@chatwarden/matcher on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/matcher): the slur matcher.
- [@chatwarden/store-sqlite on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/store-sqlite): the SQLite store.
- [@chatwarden/store-memory on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/store-memory): the in-memory store.
- [@chatwarden/http on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/http): the HTTP routes and Express adapter.
- [@chatwarden/profanity on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/profanity): the optional profanity filter.
- [@chatwarden/discord on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/discord): the Discord review-queue feed.
- [@chatwarden/hub-react on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/hub-react): the moderator hub for React.
- [@chatwarden/player-react on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/player-react): the player notices and report dialog for React.
- [@chatwarden/hub-element on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatwarden/hub-element): the moderator hub as `<chatwarden-hub>`.

- [Source repository](https://github.com/hainix/chatwarden): the code, issues and pull requests.
